```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

pacman::p_load(patchwork, ggplot2, here, fs, install = FALSE)
```

## Patch Panel A and Panel B

```{r}
#| label: patch-vae-fig
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 14

# Panel A: Architecture (loading from RDS for best quality)
panel_a <- read_rds(here("VAE/lite/VAE_graph/output/vae_architecture_pub.rds"))

# Panel B: CV Illustration (loading from RDS for best quality)
panel_b <- read_rds(here("VAE/lite/VAE_graph/output/vae_cv_pub.rds"))

# Use patchwork to combine
# Wrap panel_a to treat it as a single unit since it's already a patchwork object
combined_fig <- wrap_elements(panel_a) / panel_b + 
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') & 
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))

# Display and save
print(combined_fig)

fs::dir_create(here("VAE/lite/VAE_graph/output"))
ggsave(here("VAE/lite/VAE_graph/output/fig_suppl_vae_methodology.png"), combined_fig, width = 12, height = 14, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(here("VAE/lite/VAE_graph/output/fig_suppl_vae_methodology.pdf"), combined_fig, width = 12, height = 14, bg = "white")
```
